 Hon'Ble Mr Justice Vinod Chatterji Koul, Judge
 Order

This Court vide order dated 08.07.2027 in paras 8 and 9 observed as "8.

What transpires from the conduct of the respondents is that the land in question is not required by them and they are intending to hand over the same back to the petitioners after having possessed/used and retained the same for almost 24 years Having said that the Judgement dated 17.05.2017,
remains to be complied with, as the only course available to the respondents in terms of the said Judgement was to process the case for compensation by way of negotiation or in terms of provisions of Land Acquisition Act, if on enquiry the land was proven to be under the possession of respondents.
Admittedly, land is in possession of respondents sine more than two decades.
It would not be out of place to mention here that the Judgement dated 17.05.2017 has not been challenged by the respondents, as such, has attained finality.

The fresh compliance report dated 28.05.2024 is not consonance with the Judgement dated 17.05.2017.
9.

In the meantime, last and final opportunity is granted to the respondents to file fresh compliance report, strictly in conformity with the Judgement dated 17.05.2017, failing which, the coercive measures shall be taken against the respondents".
In terms of aforesaid order, fresh compliance has been filed.

What gets revealed from the perusal of Safiya Begum And Ors vs Manoj Kumar Dwivedi And Ors on 9 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103377529/
1 compliance report is that it is repetition of earlier compliance report which was rejected by this Court.

sentences.text: From the conduct of respondents, it appears that they are deliberately and willfully disobeying the judgement passed by this Court.

One week's last and final opportunity is granted to respondents to implement the judgement in letter and spirit, failing which respondents shall appear in person and explain as to why rule be not framed against them.
Till the next date of hearing, the salary of Chief Wildlife Warden, Srinagar, be stopped.
(VINOD CHATTERJI KOUL) JUDGE SRINAGAR 09.08.2024
